collection.title: Lotus Esprit 1988 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lotus Esprit 1988 - 2004 model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses theHook Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
